name: GitHub
description: GitHub is a developer platform where developers, agents, and code come together, described on its own site as "the world's most widely adopted developer platform" for building software collaboratively.
best_for: Positioned for teams "scaling your development process or just learning how to code," spanning startups to enterprises across industries like tech, automotive, and financial services.
features: Pull requests and code review tools
Copilot AI code assistance and Copilot Autofix

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Unlimited public and private repositories; 2,000 Actions minutes per month for private repositories, with public repositories free for Actions usage.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Per user per month; advanced collaboration features beyond Free.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Starting price per user per month; enterprise security, compliance, and deployment features. A 30-day Enterprise trial is offered.

alternatives.name: GitLab
alternatives.description: An intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps offering source control, CI/CD, and security in one product.
alternatives.best_for: End-to-end DevSecOps for enterprises, small businesses, and public-sector orgs.

alternatives.name: Bitbucket
alternatives.description: A Git solution built around deep Jira integration and Atlassian-platform CI/CD.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Jira who want reduced context-switching between planning and code.
